messages:
Alex: hey — I accepted the org invite but I only see public repos under Repositories. I thought I should see the private team repos (rw-engineering). Can someone confirm?
Sam: Did you accept the invite from your work email (alex@redwood.com) or a personal GH account?
Alex: accepted with alex@redwood.com, it shows me as a Member on the org page but nothing private.
Onboarding Bot: Invitation accepted by Alex at 2024-11-12 09:10 UTC. Added to team: rw-engineering (pending SSO).
Priya (IT): Two quick checks: 1) Do you have 2FA enabled on your GitHub account? 2) Is SAML SSO authorized for your account? If the org enforces SSO, you need to authorize it after accepting the invite.
Alex: 2FA is on. Where do I re-authorize SSO? I don't see a prompt.
Jordan: Go to GitHub > Settings > Organizations > redwood-inference — there should be an "Authorize SSO" button. If you don’t see it, try signing out and back in or use an incognito window.
Sam: also make sure you aren't signed into a different GH account in the browser (common issue). Try `gh auth status` or `gh auth login` in your terminal to confirm which account is active.
Alex: ran `gh auth status` — shows me as alex@redwood.com and org membership present.
Priya (IT): If GH shows membership but you still can't see repos, sometimes the problem is that the team doesn't have explicit repo access or the repo was added after the invite. I'll check team permissions. Can you confirm which repo you're trying to access?
Alex: platform-infra and model-serving (both private).
Priya (IT): checking...
Priya (IT): ok, rw-engineering had access to model-serving but platform-infra was only granted to "infra-team". I just added rw-engineering with Read access to platform-infra.
Sam: after Priya's change, try a hard refresh or open an incognito window. Also, if SSO hadn't been authorized earlier, that would block access until re-authorized — re-run the SSO authorize flow if needed.
Alex: can confirm model-serving still missing for me. It shows in GH UI for others.
Priya (IT): hmm — pinging @github-admin to trigger org-team sync (may be a SAML sync lag). In the meantime try: 1) sign out/in, 2) visit https://github.com/orgs/redwood-inference/people and confirm your entry shows "Member" and your teams.
Jordan: also check if your account is a duplicate (personal vs work). If you had a personal account previously linked to the same email, GitHub sometimes shows confusing membership.
Alex: checked org people — I see my name but teams column is empty.
Priya (IT): that explains it. You were added to the org but the team membership didn't attach properly (common when SSO enforced mid-invite). I'm re-adding you to rw-engineering explicitly and forcing SSO re-auth.
Onboarding Bot: Admin action: Priya re-added Alex to rw-engineering at 2024-11-12 09:23 UTC; SSO re-request sent.
Alex: got the SSO prompt and clicked Authorize. I can now see model-serving and platform-infra. :tada:
Sam: awesome — resolved? Anything else we should update in the onboarding docs to avoid this?
Priya (IT): I'll add a short note to the new-hires checklist: "If you see org membership but no teams/repos, re-authorize SAML SSO and check that team membership is listed on the Organizations page."
Alex: thanks all, that fixed it.
Jordan: welcome aboard again :wave:
